name: flowcase-monorepo
description: Monorepo for flowcase — a no-code, React-based E2E test runner built on Playwright.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @flowcase/core && npm run build -w @flowcase/server && npm run build -w @flowcase/ui && npm run build -w flowcase
scripts.build:node: npm run build -w @flowcase/core && npm run build -w @flowcase/server && npm run build -w flowcase
